001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.format;
002
003import java.util.Optional;
004import java.util.function.Consumer;
005import java.util.stream.Stream;
006
007import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
008
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.ServiceRegistry;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.AnsiSupport;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.format.PatternFormatterFactory.CompositeFactory;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.format.PatternFormatterFactory.KeywordFactory;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.internal.Node;
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.internal.Node.CompositeNode;
018import io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.internal.Node.End;
019import io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.internal.Node.FormattingNode;
020import io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.internal.Node.KeywordNode;
021import io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.internal.Node.LiteralNode;
022import io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.internal.Parser;
023import io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.internal.ScanException;
024
025/**
026 * Compiles a pattern into a formatter.
027 */
028public sealed interface PatternCompiler {
029
030        /**
031         * Compiles a pattern into a formatter.
032         * @param pattern logback style pattern.
033         * @return formatter.
034         */
035        public LogFormatter compile(String pattern);
036
037        /**
038         * Creates a pattern compiler builder. If nothing is set the default pattern registry
039         * and formatting config will be used.
040         * @return builder.
041         */
042        public static Builder builder() {
043                return new Builder();
044        }
045
046        /**
047         * Creates a pattern compiler provider from a builder lambda.
048         * @param consumer builder will be provided to the consumer.
049         * @return provider of pattern compiler.
050         */
051        public static LogProvider<PatternCompiler> of(Consumer<Builder> consumer) {
052                return (name, config) -> {
053                        var services = config.serviceRegistry();
054                        var registry = findService(services, PatternRegistry.class, name, LogProperties.DEFAULT_NAME)
055                                .orElseGet(() -> PatternRegistry.of());
056                        var patternConfig = findService(services, PatternConfig.class, name, LogProperties.DEFAULT_NAME)
057                                .orElseGet(() -> {
058                                        boolean ansiDisable = config.properties()
059                                                .forKey(LogProperties.GLOBAL_ANSI_DISABLE_PROPERTY) //
060                                                .ofBoolean() //
061                                                .or(() -> !AnsiSupport.isAnsiSupported())
062                                                .validateNow(PatternCompiler.class);
063                                        var b = PatternConfig.builder(name)
064                                                .propertyFunction(PatternConfig.propertyFunction(config.properties(),
065                                                                PatternConfig.PATTERN_PROPERY_PREFIX))
066                                                .fromProperties(config.properties());
067                                        if (ansiDisable) {
068                                                b.ansiDisabled(true);
069                                        }
070
071                                        return b.build();
072                                });
073                        Builder b = builder();
074                        b.patternRegistry(registry);
075                        b.patternConfig(patternConfig);
076                        consumer.accept(b);
077                        return b.build();
078                };
079        }
080
081        private static <T> Optional<T> findService(ServiceRegistry services, Class<T> c, String... names) {
082                Stream<String> sn = Stream.of(names);
083                return sn.flatMap(s -> Stream.ofNullable(services.findOrNull(c, s))).findFirst();
084        }
085
086        /**
087         * Builder for {@link PatternCompiler}.
088         */
089        public final static class Builder {
090
091                private @Nullable PatternRegistry patternRegistry;
092
093                private @Nullable PatternConfig patternConfig;
094
095                private Builder() {
096                }
097
098                /**
099                 * Pattern keyword registry.
100                 * @param patternRegistry keyword names registry.
101                 * @return this.
102                 */
103                public Builder patternRegistry(PatternRegistry patternRegistry) {
104                        this.patternRegistry = patternRegistry;
105                        return this;
106                }
107
108                /**
109                 * Formatting config that has platform config like time zone etc.
110                 * @param patternConfig config for formatting of keywords.
111                 * @return this.
112                 */
113                public Builder patternConfig(PatternConfig patternConfig) {
114                        this.patternConfig = patternConfig;
115                        return this;
116                }
117
118                /**
119                 * Creates a pattern compiler.
120                 * @return pattern compiler.
121                 */
122                public PatternCompiler build() {
123                        var patternRegistry_ = patternRegistry;
124                        var formatterConfig_ = patternConfig;
125                        if (patternRegistry_ == null) {
126                                patternRegistry_ = PatternRegistry.of();
127                        }
128                        if (formatterConfig_ == null) {
129                                formatterConfig_ = PatternConfig.of();
130                        }
131                        return new Compiler(patternRegistry_, formatterConfig_);
132                }
133
134        }
135
136}
137
138final class Compiler implements PatternCompiler {
139
140        private final PatternConfig config;
141
142        private final PatternRegistry registry;
143
144        Compiler(PatternRegistry registry, PatternConfig config) {
145                this.config = config;
146                this.registry = registry;
147        }
148
149        @Override
150        public LogFormatter compile(String pattern) {
151                return compile(pattern, true);
152        }
153
154        /*
155         * autoAppendException exists as a seam for tests that want to check what a single
156         * keyword compiles to in isolation, without the default exception formatter that
157         * would otherwise always be appended (see below). Real callers only ever go through
158         * the one-arg compile(String) above.
159         */
160        LogFormatter compile(String pattern, boolean autoAppendException) {
161                try {
162                        Parser p = new Parser(pattern);
163                        Node parsed = p.parse();
164                        LogFormatter formatter = compile(parsed);
165                        if (autoAppendException && !containsExceptionKeyword(parsed)) {
166                                formatter = LogFormatter.builder().add(formatter).throwable().build();
167                        }
168                        return formatter;
169                }
170                catch (ScanException | IllegalStateException e) {
171                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Pattern is invalid: " + pattern, e);
172                }
173        }
174
175        LogFormatter compile(Node start) {
176                var b = LogFormatter.builder();
177                if (start == Node.end()) {
178                        return b.build();
179                }
180
181                for (Node n = start; n != Node.end();) {
182                        n = switch (n) {
183                                case End e -> {
184                                        yield e;
185                                }
186                                case LiteralNode ln -> {
187                                        b.text(ln.value());
188                                        yield ln.next();
189                                }
190                                case FormattingNode fn -> {
191                                        PatternFormatterFactory f = registry.getOrNull(fn.keyword());
192                                        if (f == null) {
193                                                // TODO better error message
194                                                throw new IllegalStateException("Missing formatter for key: " + fn.keyword());
195                                        }
196
197                                        var _child = switch (fn) {
198                                                case CompositeNode cn -> cn.childNode();
199                                                case KeywordNode kn -> null;
200                                        };
201
202                                        var formatter = switch (f) {
203                                                case KeywordFactory kf -> kf.create(config, fn);
204                                                case CompositeFactory cf -> {
205                                                        LogFormatter child = _child == null ? null : compile(_child);
206                                                        yield cf.create(config, fn, child);
207                                                }
208                                        };
209                                        b.add(formatter);
210                                        yield fn.next();
211                                }
212                        };
213                }
214                return b.build();
215        }
216
217        /*
218         * A separate, non-mutating pass (rather than tracking state during compile() itself)
219         * so that compile(Node) keeps its original, simple recursive shape. Needs its own
220         * recursion into composite children for the same reason compile(Node) does - a
221         * keyword like %red(%ex) nests the exception keyword inside a child pattern.
222         *
223         * Checked via the resolved factory's isExceptionFormatter() rather than a fixed set
224         * of known keyword strings, so custom-registered keywords (e.g. Spring Boot's
225         * %wEx/%wex, registered entirely outside this module) are recognized too.
226         */
227        private boolean containsExceptionKeyword(Node start) {
228                for (Node n = start; n != Node.end();) {
229                        switch (n) {
230                                case End e -> {
231                                        return false;
232                                }
233                                case LiteralNode ln -> n = ln.next();
234                                case FormattingNode fn -> {
235                                        PatternFormatterFactory f = registry.getOrNull(fn.keyword());
236                                        if (f != null && f.isExceptionFormatter()) {
237                                                return true;
238                                        }
239                                        var child = switch (fn) {
240                                                case CompositeNode cn -> cn.childNode();
241                                                case KeywordNode kn -> null;
242                                        };
243                                        if (child != null && containsExceptionKeyword(child)) {
244                                                return true;
245                                        }
246                                        n = fn.next();
247                                }
248                        }
249                }
250                return false;
251        }
252
253}
